mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_explicit_cache( cache_id, user_id, api_key_id, model_alias, channel, upstream_model, upstream_response_id, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{cacheId}, #{userId}, #{apiKeyId}, #{modelAlias}, #{channel}, #{upstreamModel}, NULL, 'CREATING', #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, cache_id AS cacheId, user_id AS userId, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_alias AS modelAlias, channel, upstream_model AS upstreamModel, upstream_response_id AS upstreamResponseId, status, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_explicit_cache WHERE cache_id = #{cacheId} AND api_key_id = #{apiKeyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE router_explicit_cache SET upstream_response_id = #{upstreamResponseId}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, status = 'READY', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE cache_id = #{cacheId} AND api_key_id = #{apiKeyId} AND status = 'CREATING'
